paymentMethods.question: What payment methods do you accept?
paymentMethods.answer: We accept various payment methods for your convenience: Visa, Mastercard, Multibanco, MB WAY and PayPal. All payments are securely processed with SSL encryption to ensure your data protection.

booking.question: How can I book my trip?
booking.answer: Booking your trip is simple! Contact us through the form on the website, WhatsApp or phone. Our team will help you choose the best vehicle and time for your needs. We recommend booking in advance to ensure availability.

roundTrip.question: How does a round trip work?
roundTrip.answer: On a round trip, our driver takes you to your destination and waits for the agreed time to bring you back. You can enjoy your outing without worrying about transportation. The waiting time is flexible and can be adjusted according to your needs.

discount.question: What discount do I get for sharing a trip?
discount.answer: We offer attractive discounts for groups sharing the trip! The more people, the greater the individual discount. Contact us to receive a personalized quote based on the number of passengers and desired destination.

otherDestinations.question: Do you travel to other places?
otherDestinations.answer: Yes! We provide transfers to various destinations in Portugal and Spain. In addition to airports, we travel to tourist cities, special events, hotels and any other location you need. Ask us about your specific destination.

booking.question: How far in advance should I book?
booking.answer: We recommend booking at least 24 hours in advance to guarantee availability. However, we accommodate same-day requests whenever possible. For peak season, holidays, or large group transfers, booking 48–72 hours ahead ensures the best vehicle selection.

flightDelay.question: What happens if my flight is delayed?
flightDelay.answer: We monitor every flight in real time. If your flight is delayed, your driver’s schedule adjusts automatically — no calls, no stress. There’s no extra charge for flight delays, and your chauffeur will be waiting when you land, regardless of the time.

private.question: Are all transfers truly private?
private.answer: Yes. Every booking is a private service — you will never share your vehicle with other passengers. Your chauffeur, your vehicle, your schedule. No exceptions.

vehicles.question: Which vehicles are available?
vehicles.answer: Our fleet includes Mercedes E-Class, S-Class, V-Class, and Sprinter vans. For larger groups, we offer minibuses and full-size coaches. Every vehicle is maintained to the highest standards with complimentary water, Wi-Fi, and child seats on request.

coverage.question: Do you cover all of Portugal?
coverage.answer: We operate across mainland Portugal, from the Algarve to Porto and everywhere in between. Airport transfers, city-to-city routes, and custom itineraries are all available. We also cover cross-border transfers to Spain upon request.

faqsPage.title: FAQs Easy Transfer
faqsPage.a1: We accept cash, MB Way, PayPal, Visa and Mastercard. For special event bookings or premium services, we also offer the option to pay by bank transfer.
faqsPage.q2: How can I contact Easy Transfer / LuxMotion?
faqsPage.q3: How can I book my transfer or tour?
faqsPage.a3: You can book directly on our website, by WhatsApp/phone or by email. Confirmations are immediate and we send all booking details for your peace of mind.
faqsPage.q4: Do you only do airport transfers?
faqsPage.a4_intro: No. As well as airport transfers (Lisbon, Porto, Faro, etc.), we also provide:
faqsPage.a4_1: Private and customised tours in Portugal and Spain
faqsPage.a4_4: Private chauffeur at your disposal (by the hour or by the day)
faqsPage.a4_5: Long-distance transfers in Portugal and Europe
faqsPage.q5: How does a return trip work?
faqsPage.a5: Two legs (outbound + return) are booked with a better rate than booking separately. If the client needs to be waited for between the outbound and return, an hourly waiting fee may apply.
faqsPage.q6: Can I share the transfer and get a discount?
faqsPage.a6: Yes. If you share the transfer with other passengers, we offer 20% off per trip. The final price depends on the destination and number of passengers.
faqsPage.a7: Yes. We operate across Portugal and also organise trips to Spain. Price and availability must be agreed in advance.
faqsPage.a8_intro: Yes. LuxMotion / Easy Transfer offers exclusive, customised tours:
faqsPage.a8_1: Half-day or full-day tours (Lisbon, Sintra, Cascais, Fátima, Nazaré, Óbidos, etc.)
faqsPage.a8_2: Premium tours across Portugal (Douro, Alentejo, Algarve, Porto)
faqsPage.a8_3: Tailored experiences (gastronomy, wine, surf trips, art & culture, adventure, wellness, etc.)
faqsPage.a8_outro: All tours include an experienced driver, premium vehicle and itinerary tailored to your preferences.
faqsPage.q9: Do you provide transport for weddings?
faqsPage.a9_intro: Yes. We specialise in transport for weddings and events:
faqsPage.a9_2: Private transport for the bride and groom
faqsPage.a9_3: Full logistics with coaches, vans and luxury cars
faqsPage.q10: Can I hire a private driver for the day?
faqsPage.a10: Yes. We provide private chauffeurs at your disposal, whether for a few hours or several days, with premium vehicles and highly personalised service.
faqsPage.q11: How far in advance should I book?
faqsPage.a11: We recommend booking as far in advance as possible to secure availability, especially in peak periods (weddings, summer, Web Summit, special events).
faqsPage.a12: Yes. Our team is fluent in English, and in some cases also in French and Spanish.
faqsPage.q13: How do you ensure quality and safety?
faqsPage.a13_1: Modern, premium vehicles with full insurance
faqsPage.a13_3: Real-time flight monitoring for airport transfers
faqsPage.a13_4: Personalised service before, during and after the trip

acceptance.content: By using Easy Transfer services, you agree to comply with and be bound by these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, you should not use our services.

services.title: 2. Services Offered
services.content: Easy Transfer offers private transportation services, including airport transfers, personalized tours and chauffeur services. All services are subject to availability and confirmation.

bookings.title: 3. Bookings and Payment
bookings.content: Bookings can be made through our website or by phone. Payment must be made according to the options available at the time of booking. All prices include VAT when applicable.

cancellations.title: 4. Cancellations and Refunds
cancellations.content: Cancellation and refund policies are detailed on our Refund Policy page. Please refer to that page for detailed information on cancellation terms.

responsibilities.title: 5. Responsibilities
responsibilities.content: Easy Transfer is not responsible for delays caused by circumstances beyond our control, such as extreme weather conditions, traffic, strikes or other force majeure events.

modifications.title: 6. Modifications
modifications.content: We reserve the right to modify these Terms and Conditions at any time. Changes will take effect immediately after publication on our website.

contact.title: 7. Contact

customerCancellation.title: 1. Customer Cancellation
customerCancellation.content: Customers can cancel their bookings through our website or by contacting us directly. Refund conditions depend on the advance notice of cancellation.

moreThan48h.title: Cancellation up to 48 hours before:
moreThan48h.content: Full refund (100% of amount paid), including transfer and insurance, if applicable.

between24_48h.title: Cancellation between 24-48 hours before:
between24_48h.content: 70% refund of amount paid. 30% cancellation fee applicable.

lessThan24h.title: Cancellation less than 24 hours before:
lessThan24h.content: No refund entitlement. The full booking amount will be retained.

originalMethod.title: 3. Refund to Original Payment Method
originalMethod.content: All refunds will be processed to the original payment method used for the booking. Processing time may vary between 5 to 10 business days, depending on the payment method.

companyCancellation.title: 4. Cancellation by Easy Transfer
companyCancellation.content: In case of cancellation by Easy Transfer due to extraordinary circumstances, a full refund or the possibility of rescheduling without additional costs will be offered.

refundTerms.title: 5. Refund Terms
refundTerms.content: By selecting Refund Terms during booking, you are protected against:
refundTerms.additional: With Refund Terms active, you will be entitled to a full refund even on last-minute cancellations, subject to documentary proof when applicable.

processing.title: 6. Refund Processing
processing.content: After refund approval, the amount will be credited to your account within 5 to 10 business days. For questions about refunds, please contact us at:

aboutPage.description: Founded in 2018, Easy Transfer was born from a simple vision: to offer travelers in Portugal a safer, more reliable, and personalized alternative to taxis and ride-sharing apps.
aboutPage.descriptionPart2: We handpick every driver, maintain a fleet of premium vehicles, and treat every journey as an opportunity to showcase the best of Portuguese hospitality. From airport pickups to scenic coastal transfers, we're committed to making your travel seamless and memorable.

joinUs.title: Join Us!
joinUs.subtitle: Two ways to join the LuxMotion network — as a partner who elevates guest experiences, or as a chauffeur who sets the standard.

partner.body: Hotel, wedding venue, or luxury travel agency? Offer your guests private transport under your brand — zero operational overhead, full white-label integration, and revenue share from day one.

chauffeur.body: Drive Portugal's most demanding guests. Pre-scheduled rides, weekly payments, and a platform that manages everything so you can focus on the drive. We only accept 1 in 5 applicants — if you have the standard, we want to hear from you.

whoIsSection.body1: Founded in 2018, LuxMotion grew from a simple conviction: Portugal deserves a private transfer service that matches the quality of its finest hotels. We handpick every driver, maintain a fleet of premium vehicles, and treat every journey as an opportunity to showcase the best of Portuguese hospitality.
whoIsSection.body2: From Lisbon airport arrivals to Douro Valley tours and Algarve wedding days — we've built a platform that connects guests, hotels, and drivers in one seamless experience. One in five driver applicants makes it through. Zero compromises on the vehicle standard.

termsPage.title: Terms and Conditions
termsPage.section1Body: By using LuxMotion by EasyTransfer services, you agree to comply with and be bound by these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, you must not use our services.
termsPage.section2Body: LuxMotion by EasyTransfer provides private transport services, including airport transfers, customised tours and chauffeur services. All services are subject to availability and confirmation.
termsPage.section3Body: Bookings can be made through our website or by phone. Payment must be made according to the options available at the time of booking. All prices include VAT where applicable.
termsPage.section4Body: Cancellation and refund policies are detailed on our Refund Policy page. Please refer to that page for detailed information about cancellation terms.
termsPage.section5Body: LuxMotion by EasyTransfer is not liable for delays caused by circumstances beyond our control, such as extreme weather conditions, traffic, strikes or other force majeure events.
termsPage.section6Body: We reserve the right to modify these Terms and Conditions at any time. Changes take effect immediately upon publication on our website.
termsPage.contactIntro: For questions about these Terms and Conditions, please contact us through:

refundPage.title: Refund Policy
refundPage.section1Body: Customers can cancel their bookings through our website or by contacting us directly. Refund conditions depend on how far in advance the cancellation is made.
refundPage.section2Tier1Title: Cancellation more than 48 hours in advance:
refundPage.section2Tier1Body: Full refund (100% of the amount paid), including transfer and insurance where applicable
refundPage.section2Tier2Body: 70% refund of the amount paid. A 30% cancellation fee applies.
refundPage.section2Tier3Title: Cancellation less than 24 hours in advance:
refundPage.section2Tier3Body: No refund. The full booking amount is retained.
refundPage.section3Body: All refunds are processed back to the original payment method used at booking. Processing time can vary between 5 and 10 business days depending on the payment method.
refundPage.section4Body: If LuxMotion by EasyTransfer cancels due to extraordinary circumstances, you will be offered a full refund or the option to reschedule at no additional cost.
refundPage.section5Intro: By selecting Arrival Guarantee at booking, you are protected against:
refundPage.section5Outro: With Arrival Guarantee active, you are entitled to a full refund even on last-minute cancellations, subject to supporting documentation when applicable.
refundPage.section6Body: Once a refund is approved, the amount is credited to your account within 5 to 10 business days. For refund-related questions, please contact us via:

q1.question: What types of vehicles are available for weddings?
q1.answer: Our wedding fleet covers everything from elegant executive sedans for the couple to classic vintage cars, supercars, vans for the bridal party, and full coaches for guests. We curate the right combination for your day.

q2.question: How far in advance should I book?
q2.answer: We recommend booking 6 to 12 months in advance, especially during peak wedding season (May–October). Last-minute requests are welcome and we will always do our best to accommodate.

q3.question: Do vehicles come with a chauffeur?
q3.answer: Yes — every vehicle is provided with a fully trained, uniformed chauffeur. Discretion, punctuality, and elegance are standard. Self-drive is not available.

q4.question: Is there a minimum hire duration?
q4.answer: Wedding bookings typically start at 4 hours per vehicle, though shorter point-to-point transfers can be arranged. We will tailor the timing to your itinerary.

q5.question: Is there a maximum hire duration?
q5.answer: There is no fixed maximum. Multi-day bookings, full-weekend arrangements, and overnight requirements are all possible. Tell us your plans and we will design the schedule.

q6.question: What payment methods do you accept?
q6.answer: Visa, Mastercard, MB Way, Multibanco, PayPal, and bank transfer. International cards are accepted; payment is processed in EUR.

q7.question: What are the payment conditions?
q7.answer: We typically request a 30% deposit to confirm the booking, with the balance due before the wedding day. Bespoke terms are available for larger packages — discussed during the quote stage.

howItWorks.subtitle: More than additional income. A strategic partnership to grow your operation.

card1.body: Guaranteed minimum volume per active driver. Unlike rideshare platforms, you receive bookings in advance with full details. No surprises, no waiting.

card2.body: The Dispatcher platform gives you full control over drivers, schedules, and trips. Receive requests, assign the right driver, and track every transfer in real time. All in a simple, mobile interface.

card3.body: Drivers receive training in premium hospitality, English communication, and safety protocols. Well-trained drivers deliver better service. And earn more tips from high-value clients.

card4.body: Get paid on time, every week, by your preferred method. Bank transfer, MB Way, or PayPal. The dedicated manager is always available for any question about payments or operations.

qualityProcess.subtitle: To ensure every LuxMotion client receives a service of excellence, all partner drivers go through a careful validation process before receiving their first trip.

step1.heading: In-person interview
step1.body: Meeting with the partner manager to evaluate the company profile, available fleet, and alignment with LuxMotion standards.

step2.heading: Documentation and verification
step2.body: Validation of transport license, insurance, inspections, criminal background, and certifications of all drivers.

step3.heading: Training and protocol
step3.body: Workshop on the LuxMotion service protocol — premium hospitality, communication with international clients, and use of the Dispatcher platform.

step4.heading: Ready to operate
step4.body: Access to the internal platform. You begin receiving bookings in the following days, with permanent support during the first weeks.

operacaoDiaria.subtitle: Three simple steps from the moment you receive a booking to your weekly payout.

step1.body: The Dispatcher platform sends the booking with all details: origin, destination, client, time, and special instructions. Minimum 24 to 48 hours in advance.

step2.body: Pick an available driver from your team and assign the right vehicle. The client automatically receives the confirmation with the driver's details and photo.

step3.body: Every completed trip is logged automatically. At the end of the week the payment is processed and transferred to your account. No bureaucracy, no delays.

q1.question: Do I need a professional transport license?
q1.answer: Yes. To join the LuxMotion network, the company must hold a valid passenger transport license and drivers need a professional driver's permit. We handle the validation during onboarding.

q2.question: What is the selection process?
q2.answer: Four steps: in-person interview with the partner manager, documentation and insurance validation, training on the LuxMotion protocol, and account activation on the Dispatcher platform. It takes 2 to 3 weeks.

q3.question: How and when do I receive payments?
q3.answer: Weekly payouts, always on the same date. Choose bank transfer, MB Way, or PayPal. Every completed trip is logged automatically — no need to submit invoices.

q4.question: How does LuxMotion make money?
q4.answer: We charge a fixed booking commission to the end client, not the driver. The per-km price you receive is net. No hidden fees or variable deductions from your earnings.

q5.question: What sets LuxMotion apart from Uber or Bolt?
q5.answer: Bookings 24-48h in advance, clients from 4 and 5 star hotels, higher commissions, dedicated human support, and zero exclusivity. You can keep operating with other platforms in parallel.

q6.question: Is this a full-time job?
q6.answer: No. It's a business-to-business partnership. You set your own schedule, choose which bookings to accept, and manage your fleet however you prefer. LuxMotion guarantees minimum volume but does not require exclusivity.
